name: Compute Express Link: About CXL
notes: Consortium page describing CXL 4.0: doubles bandwidth from 64 GT/s to 128 GT/s with zero added latency, retains the CXL 3.x 256B flit format, introduces native x2 width for fan-out, up to four retimers, bundled ports combining host and Type 1/2 device ports, memory RAS enhancements, and full backward compatibility with CXL 3.x, 2.0, 1.1 and 1.0.
